title: Production WhatsApp display name remains unresolved
risk: Meta can restrict business-initiated capacity or disconnect a sender whose display name remains rejected.
recommendation: Allow the current Ikanisa Service Center review to finish and verify approval without changing the phone number.
live_change: No display-name change was executed by Codex. The latest authenticated phone-number readback shows In Review, Connected and High quality.
residual_gate: Meta must show an approved display name and the sender must remain connected with high quality.

title: No existing Meta app is MED250-specific
risk: IKANISA and Assigu actively subscribe WhatsApp messages to Supabase and expose unrelated phone choices. Empty ASSIGU apps cannot add the WhatsApp use case or have incompatible Consumer app types. Emateli Vendor has the lowest WhatsApp blast radius but still carries unrelated Facebook Login, Instagram and Emateli policy configuration.
recommendation: If an existing app must be reused, prefer Emateli Vendor 1075514900370567 because it has no connected business assets, no production phone assignment and an unsubscribed messages field. Confirm the cross-product impact, replace only its WhatsApp callback with Cloudflare, attach WABA 1188521970082273 and correct the legal URLs without disturbing its login or Instagram use cases.
live_change: The product owner instructed Codex to stop creating a new app and reuse an existing app. Existing apps were compared read-only and Emateli Vendor 1075514900370567 is the lowest-risk candidate; no asset, callback or credential was changed.
residual_gate: Confirm Emateli Vendor as the selected shared app, approve the impact on its existing login and Instagram functions and legacy policies, then verify the production WABA and phone appear after the controlled routing change.

title: Direct Meta system-user credential is not installed
risk: The Cloudflare Worker cannot call the direct Meta Cloud API and must not receive a human short-lived credential.
recommendation: Create a least-privilege system user, scope it to the confirmed existing app and WABA 1188521970082273, and install the credential only as a Cloudflare secret through a manual secret handoff.
live_change: No credential value captured or stored in the audit pack.
residual_gate: Permission scope, owner, rotation date and Cloudflare secret-name readback must be recorded.

title: Direct Meta webhook is not configured at baseline
risk: Inbound images, native locations, pharmacy replies and delivery receipts would be lost after provider migration.
recommendation: Deploy GET challenge verification and raw-body HMAC validation at the canonical Cloudflare endpoint before switching the sender.
live_change: The Meta GET challenge, raw-body HMAC verification, inbound media/location/action/status parsing and direct send runtime are implemented and tested locally but are not deployed or configured in Meta.
residual_gate: Meta challenge must pass and a signed production webhook event must be recorded exactly once.

title: Catalogue-order utility template remains under Meta review
risk: Catalogue orders cannot be initiated reliably outside the customer-service window until the exact production utility template is approved.
recommendation: Wait for Meta review, then verify that the exact template ID, language, image header, variables and quick replies remain unchanged and active.
live_change: Image-request utility and OTP templates are active; catalogue-order utility template 1068627845813387 is still in review.
residual_gate: Meta must show the template as active before final production cutover.

title: Provider cutover requires controlled rollback and message finality
risk: A partial migration can leave outbound messages on one provider and inbound replies on another.
recommendation: Deploy the Meta-capable Worker first, verify secrets and challenge, pause new sends during registration, switch one provider, then run physical end-to-end UAT with an explicit rollback version.
live_change: Migration explicitly authorized by the product owner in the Codex task.
residual_gate: One provider must own routing and production send, inbound, status and dispatch evidence must agree.

title: Product owner requires production-only deployment
risk: Provider and physical-device behavior cannot be proven on a separate staging sender before production.
recommendation: Compensate with deterministic local tests, dry-run packaging, a recorded Cloudflare rollback version and a tightly sequenced physical-phone check.
live_change: The product owner previously directed that there is no staging and all changes go to production.
residual_gate: Rollback must remain available until full production UAT passes.

title: Sensitive medicine and prescription image governance needs final approval evidence
risk: Prescription images and precise locations are sensitive and require minimization, retention and authorized pharmacy-only disclosure.
recommendation: Retain the private R2, capped nearest-10 dispatch, consent and expiry controls; complete privacy and legal approval evidence before broad launch claims.
live_change: No policy approval inferred from implementation evidence.
residual_gate: Approved privacy notice, deletion workflow, retention schedule and physical UAT are required.
